args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Found checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to all production regions was failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now run v2.3.0.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is healthy in all regions with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident**: `INC-0001` — "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0" — the on-call engineer has been paged, and the incident notes include the full rollback details and that root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is pending investigation.

Note: since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required for the rollback.
